english.title: Channel tunnel - failure to search person with access
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person permitted access to a restricted zone for the purposes of the activities of a business carried on by you, failed, without reasonable excuse, to use your best endeavours to secure that a search of

(A)_[any land, building or works,]_
(B)_[persons or property which may have been on land or in a building or in or on works,]_
(C)_[any land, building or works and of persons or property which may have been on land or in a building or in or on works,]_

occupied by you outside the tunnel system for the purposes of your business, was carried out by persons specified in a direction given to you under article 15(1) of the Channel Tunnel (Security) Order 1994 or by constables
english.legislation: Contrary to article 15(8)(a) of the Channel Tunnel (Security) Order 1994.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
